# Independent audit: full-parity best-menu whole-fiber weight obstruction

Source: `candidate dfa3dccc4c816783`, Sections1--8. Full independent read: PASS. The result concerns response weight on an assigned whole fiber, not the full convex-field capacity.

The two adjacent midpoint inclusions are exact. The D-plus-R coordinate minima remain at least-1 and the maximum sum is -5sigma/2; the T-plus-E coordinate maxima equal b and its minima are at least-1. The resulting support-height sequences are concave for every continuous linear functional, so the canonical hull preserves all four prescribed integer fibers. The actual pooled covariance is positive and smooth in the compact L interval for fixed sigma, and is invariant under coordinate exchange.

The source0 zero-width branch formulas follow from the exact triangle edge-intercept AM-GM calculation. The cap equation has unique proper branch minima with positive angular second derivative. The equalization equation is 12t^2-4t+sigma^2=0 with the stated root between1/4 and1/3. Its common area lies in[2,2+v].

The A-branch outside quota holds for every normal and every real base tilt, including branch-boundary normals: A maximal implies both normal coordinates are nonpositive and at least one is negative. If D is not fully captured, its negative-margin witness makes the entire square[-1/2,1/2]^2 in R strictly captured, because each coordinate of X_D+X-2Y is uniformly negative. Its area one exceeds v. Thus equality requires all of D and none of R or E. The B,C proposed tilts have the stated strict -sigma/2+O(sigma^2) margins on D and R and a fixed negative margin on E. The A tilt a=-3 has a fixed positive margin on D and fixed negative margins on the other outside fibers. Consequently all three patterns persist at sufficiently small width, uniformly in L.

The positive-width passage is rigorous: on neighborhoods of the proper vertex cuts the ordinary cap area is smooth in threshold, mark and normal, and averaging it over the finite outward width preserves this smoothness from h=0. The nondegenerate angular minima and the compact strict gap to other branch directions give unique smoothly varying branch minima. The equalization derivative V(24t-4)/3 is positive. Coordinate-exchange symmetry supplies q_B=q_C, and the implicit-function theorem gives the actual diagonal mark. Every normal belongs to a maximum-vertex branch, so the outside quotas and own branch minima prove the full ambient lower bound. Equality classifies all active directions and all outside patterns, not just a witness menu. The three spanning positively balanced normals also prove unique fiber0 maximality by frozen-cap threshold decrease.

The source1 square argument is particularly robust. If E is not fully captured, its witness X_E gives the translated center v_E=2c-X_E in[4sigma,4sigma+L]^2, a subset of[0,.041]^2. The square v_E+[-1/4,1/4]^2 lies inside T. Its half on the positive side of the resulting normal has area1/8, larger than L^2<=16sigma. This proves the all-normal, all-tilt outside quota L^2. Large positive tilts attain it for every continuous direction, and equality forces exact saturation. The central-symmetry/convex-superlevel argument makes c a maximum of the own smoothed objective for its actual covariance norm; uniqueness follows from positive own coarea and the same normal-moment identity. At other marks, the large-tilt upper bound suffices to prove strict loss from that maximum.

The two actual source values cross as L ranges from2sqrt(sigma) to4sqrt(sigma), by the explicit zero-width interval[8sigma-8sigma^2,8sigma-(7/2)sigma^2]. All relevant minima and the source mark depend continuously on(h,L), uniformly on this compact parameter interval. The intermediate-value tie at every sufficiently small positive h is therefore exact. The two small exposed endpoint fibers cannot be deepest. This proves that I={0,1} is the complete deepest set and that every active cap at both sources has zero outside coarea.

At source0 there are exactly three continuous active directions, with one uniquely determined positive response dependence after coarea reweighting. Different base tilts do not change their prescribed saturation patterns or their coareas. Hence every menu has the same total A response weight, converging uniformly to(4t-1)/(6t-1)<1/3. Its strict upper bound3/8 for small positive h is valid for the BEST menu as well. The parity forest assigns D at-1 to source0, so the proposed Gamma-weighted assigned-fiber credit is refuted under full occupied source parity and zero outside coarea.

Finally the normal-localized hinge[x+y+2-3sigma]_+ isolates the entire triangle facet x+y=1: the only other fiber facet with that normal belongs to D, on which the hinge vanishes. Square facet normals are different. The exact efficiency4t^2/(6t-1)=4/9+4(3t-1)^2/[9(6t-1)] is strictly above Gamma_2 for fixed sigma>0. Kernel traces and menu weights converge uniformly, so sufficiently small h preserves the strict payment. Thus the construction does not contradict a full convex-field capacity bound in the saturated case.

No correction was required. The example is consistent with the three-cap thin-edge vacancy theorem: in dimension two there are only two complementary vertex caps, and its missing third coordinate restriction permits the square source to carry the required mass.
